title: Closing-Slip Points in the Appraisal Order Late-Rush Refund
content:
Closing-slip points — Appraisal Order late-rush refund

The closing-slip points of the late-rush refund count the calendar days by which the closing date currently scheduled on the loan file falls after the contract closing date: a slip of 10 days or more adds 20 percentage points, a slip of 1 to 9 days adds 10 points, and no slip adds nothing. The loan file is the Mortgage Loan File the Appraisal Order supports; both dates are read from it. The points are added to the percentage on which the refund share of the late-rush refund is built, and the refund share, with the points added, is never more than 100 percent and never less than zero.

| Scheduled closing date on the Mortgage Loan File, after its contract closing date | Points |
|---|---|
| 10 calendar days or more | 20 |
| 1 to 9 calendar days | 10 |
| On or before the contract closing date | 0 |

A loan file that does not carry both dates (a refinance has no contract closing date) shows no slip and adds nothing.

**Worked readings (hypothetical: contract closing date the 1st of a month).**
- Scheduled closing on the 10th: slip 9 days, 10 points.
- Scheduled closing on the 11th: slip 10 days, 20 points.
- Scheduled closing on the 1st: no slip, no points.
